name: Plugin builder
description: Adds a /plugin command that sets a Work worker up to write a new Zeff plugin for you — Zeff extending itself.
author: Zeff examples

workCommands.label: plugin
workCommands.description: Have a worker write a new Zeff plugin
workCommands.template:
Write a Zeff plugin that does this:

<describe what it should add or change in Zeff>

How to go about it:
1. Read Zeff's plugin docs as plain Markdown: http://127.0.0.1:9333/ext/raw/README first (it says where this computer's plugins folder is), then /ext/raw/manifest, /ext/raw/api, /ext/raw/panels and /ext/raw/hooks as needed. (If Zeff isn't on port 9333, use the address in my browser.)
2. Create the plugin as a folder in that plugins folder, named like its id, with a zeff-plugin.json. Ask for the fewest permissions that work; say plainly if it needs "exec".
3. Zeff loads it at once — no restart. Check it shows up under Menu → Plugins → External plugins without an error ("Not loaded: …"), and that its files are all there.
4. Tell me what you made, what it asks for, and where I turn it on. Don't turn it on yourself.
